items.headline: xAI: Grok API text watermarking on by default from Sat 7 Nov
items.why: Covers grok-4.7/4.6/4.5/4.3/4.20 plus tool-call arguments. Team admins can opt out per model.

items.headline: OpenAI signs four Abu Dhabi deals spanning energy, government, and investment
items.why: ADNOC deploys GPT models on UAE in-country inference; machine-readable government pilot; Mubadala and a five-year Inception42 pact.

items.headline: Pika H3 Flex reaches the Pika creation product
items.why: Open weights and API launched 29 Oct on MiniMax H3. Consumer app date was Nov 2 per Pika’s own post.

items.headline: OpenAI: ChatGPT and Codex will share one usage allowance in December
items.why: Plus, Pro, and Business metered in tokens across both. Instant chat stays free of the allowance. No exact start day or sizes yet.

items.headline: FT/WSJ: OpenAI cuts raise target to ~$20B from $30B after ~$11B in
items.why: Reported only; OpenAI has not confirmed. Valuation cited around $1.25T, down from about $1.4T.

items.headline: DeepSeek open-sources dsh-superagent coding-agent prototype (MIT)
items.why: Harness-team research code for one GitHub repo. README says not an official product and not identical to the internal design article.

items.headline: Google, OpenAI, Microsoft back one robots.txt AI-training opt-out signal
items.why: usage_ai-training draft. Google says support in 2027; OpenAI “in coming months.” Bing posted the same day.

items.headline: Apple Intelligence coming to China: Qwen-powered beta Wed 4 Nov
items.why: Developer beta 4 Nov; public rollout in December with iOS 27.3. Powers Siri, Writing Tools, and Visual Intelligence in China.

items.headline: Mistral releases open weights for Large 4 (Le Chonk)
items.why: 1.1T MoE, 52B active, 1M context, multimodal in / text out. Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight license (MIT-like; MaaS needs a separate commercial license).

items.headline: AA: Mistral Large 4 (high) scores 26 on Intelligence Index v5
items.why: Independent. Trails DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM-5.3 (both 32). AA Terminal-Bench 25% and FrontierCode 15% vs Mistral’s claimed 41% and 19.7%.

items.headline: Amazon: AWS sales +39% YoY to $46.0B; $184B annualized run rate
items.why: Fastest AWS growth in nearly five years per the IR release. Jassy projects AWS growth over 40% in 2027 and 2028.

items.headline: Amazon Bedrock: Fortune 500 spend nearly 7x YoY; tokens nearly 17x
items.why: Official IR. Also Bedrock Managed Agents public preview (OpenAI-powered) and open-sourced Strands harness (32% token claim is lab).

items.headline: Amazon: TTM free cash flow outflow $42.4B; 2026 cash capex still ~$220B
items.why: PPE purchases drove the swing; Amazon says the increase primarily reflects AI investments. Capex guide unchanged in the same release.

items.headline: Call: Amazon to sell Trainium AI chips outside AWS starting late 2027
items.why: From a third-party earnings transcript, not Amazon’s IR page. Also reported: AWS backlog $578B; Q3 cash capex about $75.9B.

items.headline: Google shutting down Jules coding agent; folds into Antigravity
items.why: Sessions usable until 11 Nov, then read-only; winds down 31 Dec. Export tool available. Learnings move into Antigravity.

items.headline: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon; AA Index v5 #1 at 59 (high)
items.why: Fairwind cyber-defender preview first. Argon stays live; Google says Carbon builds on Argon, not that it replaces it.

items.headline: Carbon price: intro $2/$10 then $4/$20; 1M context; text out
items.why: Same intro path as Argon. AA charts use standard $4/$20. Multimodal input; text output per AA.

items.headline: Alphabet: Google Cloud revenue grew 103% YoY on AI infra demand
items.why: Pichai: AI infra and solutions drive Cloud. SEC release: Cloud operating income $11.1B vs $3.6B a year ago; TPU systems a meaningful contributor.

items.headline: Microsoft: Azure +48%; Microsoft Cloud $63.9B, up 30%
items.why: Commercial remaining performance obligation up 73% to $677B. Official Q1 FY27 release.

items.headline: Nvidia ships open-weight Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe (OpenMDW-1.1)
items.why: ~4.3B active; 40 languages; recordings up to one hour. Nvidia claims best open-weights Open ASR Leaderboard WER; treat as lab until independent recheck.

items.headline: Report: DeepSeek and Moonshot distilled GPT-6 Astra for latest models
items.why: The Information via Reuters; OpenAI, DeepSeek, and Moonshot did not immediately comment. Status is reported only.

items.headline: Report: DOJ inquiring about Nvidia’s ~$12.9B Hugging Face deal
items.why: Reuters exclusive; CNBC also heard it. DOJ, Nvidia, and Hugging Face have not confirmed. Inquiry is not a finding.

items.headline: Liquid AI ships LFM3: six open-weight ~2B models on one backbone
items.why: Text, vision, audio, omni, and two decision models. Built to fine-tune on one GPU and run on phones or laptops.

items.headline: LFM3-1.7B: 256K context, ~1GB at 4-bit; AA has no Index score yet
items.why: Liquid's own 29-bench average is 49.37 vs 47.24 for Qwen3.5-9B. Treat lab benches as marketing until AA or Epoch confirm.

items.headline: DeepMind Genie 4 adds native audio to real-time interactive world sims
items.why: Trusted-tester preview now; later for Google AI Ultra Project Genie and early Gemini API partners. SynthID on outputs.

items.headline: LiteLLM Critical: Enterprise proxy unauth file read can leak master key
items.why: Affects licensed Enterprise proxies only. Open-source without a license is not hit. Patch to the listed fixed versions.

items.headline: OpenAI and Oracle put Oracle apps and data into ChatGPT
items.why: Oracle AI Workspace, Security Mesh, App Composer, and SMB Bundle. US buyers can use Universal Credits on Marketplace.

items.headline: Anthropic posts early Claude results with six drug-development partners
items.why: BigHat, BMS, Divergence, Enveda, Generate, and The Column Group. Mostly preclinical; Anthropic also acquired Mithril Medicine.

items.headline: Anthropic expands GSA OneGov deal: 40% off Claude for all US government levels
items.why: Covers Enterprise, Claude for Government, and API. No minimum spend. Anthropic estimates about $1B in government savings.

items.headline: Nvidia will invest $3B in Meta's equity raise and deepen Muse work
items.why: Also more Vera Rubin and Vera CPU for Meta agents, plus Spectrum-X and BlueField-4. Follows Meta's large AI financing plan.

items.headline: Oracle will offer Google TPUs on OCI starting in calendar 2027
items.why: First hyperscaler outside Google to rent Google TPUs. TPU 8t for training and TPU 8i for inference are named.

items.headline: Next week: Apple Mon 2 Nov; AMD Tue 3 Nov after the close
items.why: Apple call 5:00 PM ET. CoreWeave reports Tue 10 Nov. Jules goes read-only Wed 11 Nov.

items.headline: Apple FY26 Q4 after the close; call 5:00 PM ET
items.why: First Ternus-as-CEO print. Market will listen for AI / Siri and the China Apple Intelligence timing.

items.headline: Kimi K3.1 Pro weights promised by Moonshot
items.why: Moonshot's K3.1 Pro blog says the full model weights will be released by 4 Nov 2026.

items.headline: Moonshot says Kimi K3.1 Pro weights come by 4 Nov
items.why: API is live; Artificial Analysis already ranks the model near the top of its Index.

items.headline: Moonshot: Kimi K3.1 Pro weights by 4 Nov
items.why: Weights still outstanding after the API/product launch.

items.headline: Moonshot: Kimi K3.1 Pro weights still due by 4 Nov
items.why: Weights still outstanding. HF still shows Kimi-K3 only as of this morning. Site stub live.

items.headline: Kimi K3.1 Pro full weights still promised by Nov 4
items.why: API and apps already live. As of this morning Moonshot’s HF org still shows Kimi-K3, not K3.1 Pro.

items.headline: Anthropic is expected to start pitching its IPO to investors the week of 9 November
items.why: Per Reuters' sources. Under SEC rules the S-1 must be public 15 days before that pitch starts, so it should land by late October.
